title: Thuyamyint
descriptionAboutMe: I deliver end-to-end software solutions. I design, build, and operate scalable systems across frontend, backend, infrastructure, deployment, and operations. My expertise includes system architecture, CI/CD automation, cloud resource management, and shipping reliable, production-ready applications.
stack: Next.js · Go · Node.js · AWS · CI/CD · Infrastructure
stackReact: I use Next.js as the frontend application framework to build performant, SEO-friendly, and scalable user interfaces. The application is structured around server and client boundaries, allowing pages to be rendered on the server when appropriate for performance and search visibility, while preserving rich client-side interactivity where needed. Routing and layouts are handled through Next.js App Router, enabling clear separation of concerns, automatic code splitting, and predictable navigation flows. Shared UI elements are implemented as layout components to maintain consistency across the application. For data handling, I combine server-side data fetching with client-side caching using TanStack Query. This approach minimizes unnecessary network requests, improves perceived performance, and keeps UI state synchronized with backend data. Styling is managed with Tailwind CSS, allowing rapid iteration while maintaining a consistent design system. Asset optimization, including images and fonts, is handled natively by Next.js to ensure efficient delivery and optimal loading behavior.
stackBackend: I design backend services with clear domain boundaries, focusing on maintainability, performance, and reliability. APIs are implemented using Node.js and Go, with stateless services, structured validation, and explicit error handling. Business logic is organized around domain services to support scalability and long-term evolution.
stackData: I work with both document-based and relational databases design and Redis for caching and data persistence, selecting the appropriate data model based on access patterns and consistency requirements. Emphasis is placed on schema , indexing strategy, and query performance to ensure reliable data access under production load.
stackInfra: I manage infrastructure using cloud-native services and infrastructure-as-code practices. Deployments are automated through CI/CD pipelines, with containerized services, environment isolation, and repeatable provisioning to ensure consistency across development and production environments.
stackMicroservices: I design and operate microservice-based systems with clear service boundaries and independent deployment lifecycles. Each service is containerized using Docker and communicates through well-defined APIs or asynchronous messaging where appropriate. Traffic routing and edge concerns are handled via an API gateway or reverse proxy, enabling centralized authentication, rate limiting, and observability. For inter-service communication and background processing, message brokers are used to decouple services and improve system resilience. The architecture emphasizes fault isolation, horizontal scalability, and operational visibility, allowing individual services to evolve without impacting the overall system.
systemArchitectureDescription: This system is designed as a layered, service-oriented architecture. The frontend is built with Next.js to provide server-rendered and client-rendered experiences with clear separation between UI, data fetching, and state management. An API gateway coordinates requests and handles authentication, validation, and routing. Core business logic is implemented as independent microservices, allowing each domain to scale and evolve without impacting others. Data persistence and caching are managed through dedicated data stores to ensure consistency and performance. Infrastructure is containerized and deployed on cloud-based virtual servers with automated CI/CD pipelines, enabling reliable, repeatable deployments and operational stability.
